name: qa-skills
description: Comprehensive skill pack for Senior QA Engineers covering the entire software testing lifecycle
author: javalenciacai

skills.name: user-story-verifier
skills.description: Validates user stories for quality, completeness, INVEST criteria, and ISTQB applicability

skills.name: test-design-istqb
skills.description: Apply ISTQB Foundation Level test design techniques including equivalence partitioning, boundary value analysis, decision tables, and state transition testing

skills.name: test-execution-manager
skills.description: Manage test execution lifecycle including test suite runs, defect logging, exploratory testing, and execution reporting

skills.name: defect-lifecycle-manager
skills.description: Manage the complete defect lifecycle from discovery through closure, including logging, tracking, metrics analysis, and root cause analysis

skills.name: cicd-testing-integration
skills.description: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines for continuous testing, including pipeline configuration and test automation strategies

skills.name: browser-use
skills.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction

skills.name: qa-process-improvement
skills.description: Drive continuous improvement of QA processes through metrics analysis, retrospectives, and best practice adoption

skills.name: multi-agent-orchestration
skills.description: Design and coordinate multi-agent systems where specialized agents work together to solve complex problems

skills.name: skill-creator
skills.description: Guide for creating effective skills that extend agent capabilities with specialized knowledge and workflows

skills.name: find-skills
skills.description: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions or express interest in extending capabilities
